#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class FFT {
public:
    static vector<double> cs, sn, csi, sni;

    static void initialize() {
        size_t size = 1 << 21;
        cs.resize(size);
        sn.resize(size);
        csi.resize(size);
        sni.resize(size);
        for (int len = 1; len <= (int)size; len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = len / 2; i < len; i++) {
                cs[i] = cos(2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
                sn[i] = sin(2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
                csi[i] = cos(-2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
                sni[i] = sin(-2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
            }
        }
    }

    static void fft(vector<double>& a, vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
        int n = (int)a.size();
        int shift = 32 - __builtin_clz(n);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_bitreverse(i << shift) >> shift;
            if (i < j) {
                swap(a[i], a[j]);
                swap(b[i], b[j]);
            }
        }
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int halfLen = len >> 1;
            int w = (int)cs.size() / len;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0, k = 0; j < halfLen; j++, k += w) {
                    double wA = inverse ? csi[halfLen + j] : cs[halfLen + j];
                    double wB = inverse ? sni[halfLen + j] : sn[halfLen + j];

                    double uA = a[i + j];
                    double uB = b[i + j];

                    double vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wA - b[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                    double vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wB + b[i + j + halfLen] * wA;

                    a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                    b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                    a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                    b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
                }
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i] /= n;
                b[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
};

vector<double> FFT::cs;
vector<double> FFT::sn;
vector<double> FFT::csi;
vector<double> FFT::sni;

vector<int> multiplyMod(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = (int)a.size() + (int)b.size() - 1;
    int n = 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(need - 1));
    vector<double> aReal(n), aImag(n), bReal(n), bImag(n);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
        int x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        aReal[i] = (double)(x & ((1 << 15) - 1));
        aImag[i] = (double)(x >> 15);
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < b.size(); i++) {
        int x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        bReal[i] = (double)(x & ((1 << 15) - 1));
        bImag[i] = (double)(x >> 15);
    }

    FFT::fft(aReal, aImag, false);
    FFT::fft(bReal, bImag, false);

    vector<double> faReal(n), faImag(n), fbReal(n), fbImag(n);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2.0;
        double a1i = (aImaginary[i] - aImaginary[j]) / 2.0;
        double a2r = (aImaginary[i] + aImaginary[j]) / 2.0;
        double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2.0;

        double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2.0;
        double b1i = (bImaginary[i] - bImaginary[j]) / 2.0;
        double b2r = (bImaginary[i] + bImaginary[j]) / 2.0;
        double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2.0;

        faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        faImag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;

        fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        fbImag[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    FFT::fft(faReal, faImag, true);
    FFT::fft(fbReal, fbImag, true);

    vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = (long long)(faReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long bb = (long long)(fbReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long cc = (long long)(faImag[i] + 0.5);
        long long val = (aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod;
        res[i] = (int)val;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    FFT::initialize();

    int mod = 998244353;
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;

    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        v[x] = 1;
    }

    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int p = n / 2;
    while (true) {

            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, mod);
        }
        p /= 2;
        if (p == 0) break;
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, mod);
    }

    long long res = 0;
    for (auto x : ans) {
        res = (res + ((long long)x * x) % mod) % mod;
    }
    cout << res << "\n";

    return 0;
}
